Native disclosure controls, visual shaders, preset metadata, bloom helpers
and three interface icons are reused in RELIC. Original Vue views and selected CSS are included as
unchanged comparison sources for the adapted locked-world interface.
RELIC supplies its own planet data, navigation and renderer integration.
See PROVENANCE.json for exact paths and SHA-256 hashes.

No third-party upstream datasets, models, provider credentials or keys are
bundled by this integration. The upstream code license does not license
third-party data; the upstream LICENSE retains its explanatory notice.
